title: Which Acoustic Features Survive Compression? Tracker-Estimated First-Formant Statistics for Codec-Robust Audio DeepfakeDetection
abstract: arXiv:2611.13258v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio deepfake detectors that work well on clean lab recordings often degrade after telephone or platform compression. This paper asks a specific question: which low-dimensional acoustic descriptors stay informative after codec degradation? We screen 36 utterance-level features(formants, PNCCs, LFCCs, prosody) on ASVspoof 2019 data and test on the official ASVspoof 2021 LA set across seven codec conditions. Of 33 statistically significant descriptors, only four show large practical separation (|r| >0.5, bootstrap 95% CIs), all first-formant (F1) measures, highly redundant (PC1: 79% variance). The payoff is stability: the 36-feature SVM degrades 14 pp under codec mismatch (9.5%-23.5% EER), while the four-feature RBF-SVM degrades only 5.9 pp (17.0%-22.9%). The F1 subset varies 3.4 pp across conditions versus 13.1 pp for the full set. F1 differences persist after controlling for speaker identity (p greater than 10^10, mixed-effects model)

translated_title: 哪些声学特征能在压缩中幸存？用于编解码器鲁棒音频深度伪造检测的追踪器估计第一共振峰统计特征
translated_abstract: 在干净实验室录音上表现良好的音频深度伪造检测器，在经过电话或平台压缩后往往会性能下降。本文提出了一个具体的问题：哪些低维声学描述子在编解码器降质后仍能保持信息量？我们在ASVspoof 2019数据上筛选了36个语句级特征（共振峰、PNCC、LFCC、韵律），并在官方ASVspoof 2021 LA测试集上于七种编解码器条件下进行测试。在33个具有统计显著性的描述子中，仅有四个展现出较大的实际区分度（|r| > 0.5，bootstrap 95%置信区间），且全部为第一共振峰（F1）相关度量，彼此高度冗余（PC1解释了79%的方差）。其价值在于稳定性：36特征SVM在编解码器失配下性能退化14个百分点（EER从9.5%升至23.5%），而四特征RBF-SVM仅退化5.9个百分点（EER从17.0%升至22.9%）。F1特征子集在各条件间的波动为3.4个百分点，而全特征集为13.1个百分点。在控制说话人身份后，F1差异依然显著（p < 10^-10，混合效应模型）。
tldr: 该论文发现第一共振峰（F1）统计特征在编解码器压缩后仍保持对深度伪造语音的判别力，仅用四个F1特征构建的SVM在七种编解码器条件下性能仅退化5.9个百分点（远优于36特征模型的14个百分点），为编解码器鲁棒的音频深度伪造检测提供了极简且稳定的特征方案。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that first-formant (F1) statistics remain discriminative after codec degradation, and a four-feature RBF-SVM built on them degrades only 5.9 pp across seven codec conditions (vs. 14 pp for a 36-feature model), offering a minimal yet stable feature set for codec-robust audio deepfake detection.
